row.evidence: Cribl's Members docs say 'When you remove a Member in the IdP, they are still listed as a Member on Cribl.Cloud', and admins must remove them manually. SSO (OIDC/SAML) is Enterprise-only and no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: None by absence: the IAM docs index, the full docs sitemap and the API reference have no SCIM. Cribl.Cloud SSO (OIDC or SAML) is on Enterprise ('RBAC & Federated Auth'). SSO members appear to be created at sign-in and get permissions from IdP group names mapped to Teams, but IdP removals do not reach Cribl. The Okta OIN app (Cribl Cloud) is SAML-only. Cribl does publish a REST user-management API (control plane /system/users, /system/teams) using OAuth client-credentials API Credentials. An IdP connector could use it, but none is documented. Pricing is usage-based in Cribl Credits, with no per-user price.
row.user_api_plan: All plans (API Credentials; Organization Permissions on some tiers)

plans.name: Standard
plans.price_text: Usage-based in Cribl Credits, up to 5TB/day

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Usage-based in Cribl Credits, unlimited TB/day
plans.notes: Enterprise adds 'RBAC & Federated Auth'. The feature table marks External Auth (OpenID & SAML) for Enterprise only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented. Removing a user in the IdP does not remove the Cribl.Cloud Member (c6).

user_api.notes: The plan is inferred: the API docs gate only Organization Permissions on API Credentials by tier ('Without a proper license, all API Credentials are granted the Admin Permission'), not API access itself. The user payload has username, email, first/last name, disabled, roles and Cribl.Cloud workspaceRoles. Several Roles endpoints are on-prem only.

auth.notes: API Credential Client ID and Secret exchanged at https://login.cribl.cloud/oauth/token (client_credentials) for a 24-hour Bearer JWT. On-prem uses POST /auth/login, with a default TTL of 3600 seconds. The token's scope is the credential's Permissions.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate and reactivate use the 'disabled' boolean on PATCH /system/users/{id}. Groups are Cribl Teams.

endpoints.purpose: List all users who have access to a Cribl product
Get the access control list for a user of a Cribl product
Get the Access Control List for a Team

limitations.text: Assigning the Organization 'User' Permission (workspace-scoped access) requires an Enterprise plan.

okta.notes: The OIN page ticks SAML only; SCIM and the provisioning functions are not ticked. Cribl's own Okta guides use a custom app integration (Create App Integration).

entra.notes: Cribl documents a custom SAML 2.0 enterprise application. There is no Microsoft Learn tutorial in the saas-apps table of contents.

fallbacks.other_sync: IdP group names in SSO assertions map to Cribl Teams and Permissions at sign-in (Mapping IDs)
fallbacks.notes: JIT is inferred: with SSO, 'the identity provider (IdP) admin manages Members in the IdP system', and SAML assertions carry email, given_name, family_name and groups 'to correctly provision and authorize users'. Removal still has to be done in Cribl.Cloud.
